subject: general
question: With which defense organisation has the Indian Navy jointly conducted successful combat trials of the indigenously developed Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM) in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is the premier agency responsible for the research and development of defense technologies in India.
 
• In **May 2025**, the Indian Navy collaborated with DRDO to conduct successful combat trials of the **indigenously developed Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM)**.
 
• The **Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM)** is a state-of-the-art mine designed for maritime defense applications. It incorporates multiple sensors to detect and respond to various types of threats.
 
• The successful trials mark a significant milestone in India’s efforts to achieve **self-reliance** in defense technology under the government’s **‘Make in India’ initiative**.
 
• This achievement reflects the robust partnership between the Indian Navy and DRDO in enhancing India’s maritime security capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):**

 
 
• Established in **1958**, DRDO operates under the Ministry of Defense, Government of India.
 
• Headquartered in **New Delhi**, DRDO oversees over **50 laboratories** dedicated to research in aeronautics, armaments, electronics, combat vehicles, engineering systems, and more.
 
• DRDO has been instrumental in developing technologies such as the **BrahMos missile**, **Agni series** of ballistic missiles, and **Akash surface-to-air missile systems**.
 
 
 
• **Multi-Influence Ground Mine (MIGM):**
 
 
• This indigenously developed mine integrates multiple sensors, such as **magnetic, acoustic, and seismic sensors**, to detect various threats in marine environments.
 
• MIGM is designed for deployment on the seabed to target enemy ships and submarines effectively.
 
• It enhances operational flexibility and supports India’s maritime defense strategy by safeguarding critical sea routes and installations.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy’s Role in Defense Innovation:**
 
 
• The Indian Navy actively collaborates with DRDO and other defense organizations to develop advanced technologies for maritime security.
 
• Recent initiatives include the induction of platforms such as the **INS Vikrant** (India’s indigenous aircraft carrier) and advanced frigates and submarines.
 
• Such collaborations aim to reduce dependence on foreign imports and boost indigenous defense production.
 
 
 
• **‘Make in India’ Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India in **2014**, the initiative aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.
 
• The defense sector is a key focus area, promoting the indigenization of military hardware and technology.
 
• Under this initiative, defense organizations like DRDO have been encouraged to innovate and produce cutting-edge systems.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **DRDO’s Achievements:**

 
 
• DRDO has successfully developed strategic missile systems like **Prithvi, Agni, and BrahMos**.
 
• Advanced radar systems, combat vehicles, and electronic warfare systems are among its notable contributions.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy’s Modernization:**
 
 
• The Indian Navy has consistently focused on modernizing its fleet with indigenous platforms, including **submarines, destroyers, and aircraft carriers**.
 
• The induction of sophisticated technologies like MIGM strengthens its capability to protect India’s maritime interests.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of Maritime Defense:**
 
 
• India’s geographical location makes maritime security crucial for protecting trade routes and ensuring regional stability.
 
• Developments like MIGM enhance India’s ability to deter threats in its territorial waters and Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).
